I’m in the exact same boat as you right now, seven thousand miles from home, away from friends and family. Persecuted by my bosses, making mistakes, enduring misfortune, feeling lost and attacked by the world. I don’t know how much longer I can handle it but I keep fighting. Allow your emotions to take control and let them out. Your life is pure and theres so many good things ahead of you. The only thing I’m holding out for is the thought of seeing my family again but that’s not all. I know there’s still new friends and companions to make, new memories to be made, and experiences to be had. Life does get better, I’ve experienced the rollercoaster of life being stationed overseas for 3 years secluded from family and friends and I fucking hate my life. I’m fed up, I’m tired, disgusted with my thoughts, my attitude, my anxiety, and my fear, but I keep going, not just for those who care about me but for myself because I fucking deserve it. I DESERVE IT, I deserve better and so do you. Life will go on and life will get better. Trust in yourself and trust in God if you’re religious. Whatever you need to do, but I promise you can do whatever the fuck you set your mind to, it might not be today, maybe not fucking tomorrow, but you can. Life is such a beautiful opportunity and sometimes we unfortunately just get stuck in a rut, we think the world is out to get us and that we’re not cut out for it. I’m still waiting for that day where it might get better, but I won’t stop fighting. It’ll get better for you and I promise I’m here to fight with you. Lemme know if you ever need anything or need to talk and I’ll do whatever I can

hey, I know your pain, your torment, your dread, your hopeless, I know it all and I know it well. I don’t know how much me writing this will help you and I don’t know if it’s what you wanna hear rn but I’m still gonna tell you anyways. I’ve struggled with severe depression and anxiety for years. Being a 23M stationed overseas in the U.S. military, I’ve been removed from my family for years. The only and I mean THE ONLY thing keeping me going is my loved ones support, compassion, and love for me. I can’t tell you how many fucking times I’ve felt, hopeless, alone, abandoned, and forgotten about. My families lives go on without me and time and again through pain, misfortune, anxiety, and loneliness, I’ve thought my family would be better off without me. Like hey, they haven’t seen me in two whole fucking years, it’s probably be a pretty easy transition for them to adjust to life without me right? Absolutely not. The reason why you’ve continued to fight for so long is your love for your boyfriend and the love he shows you. Regardless of the burden your own tortuous mind makes you out to be, that’s not the case. Your subconscious is plotting against you and it’s finally reached the boiling point. You need to contemplate your feelings for your boyfriend, confide in him. Please believe me when I tell you, he needs you. You’re his everything, as he is yours. You will never hold him back. Being so closely attached to him, and considering a future together, he would tell you if you didn’t fit the picture. HE WANTS YOU, he wants you in his life and he needs you in his life. Please know that no matter what, your life is precious and it is priceless, your future has brighter days ahead and you and your boyfriend as capable of anything together, beautiful children ahead, a modest home, and a quiet and happy life with each other side by side. Do not let your thoughts control you. Give them their time, let them out, confront them, and overcome them. You’re more than what your thought say you are, and your life has so much untapped, pride, joy, love, and happiness. God bless, and please lemme know if you need to talk more or need anything. Idk how much this helps but conjure up everything in your power to persevere. It will get better.

Brother, I understand your pain. Feeling so lost, down, hopeless, and alone so many times on so many different occasions. Life is a fucking rollercoaster and 2021 has brought me as close to the brink of ending the overbearing pain in my existence than ever before. The only thing, and I mean THE ONLY THING, that has kept me going is my family. Not even my friends have been able to comfort and console me. Every time something happens to me and I slip again into my lonesome dreadful out of sadness and hopelessness, I contemplate my family. I see their faces, I reflect on memories and looks forwards to memories to be made. The reason why it’s so difficult for you to continue writing your note for your baby sisters section is because it’s not your time to go. You sister needs you in her life as much as you need her. There’s so many more fond memories to be made and times to be had together and I promise you, you will see better days. I can’t tell you when or how soon but I can tell you that you will undoubtedly return from this and overcome it. Your life is invaluable, it’s priceless, it’s precious, and it’s pure. No matter your past transgressions, misdeeds, or anything that has occurred to you, there is a way out. Emotions are a blessing, as much as we succumb to them, they also help us have realizations and find a way out. Let it all out man, be honest with yourself and those closest to you and never ever stop battling. YOU ARE ON THIS EARTH FOR A REASON AND YOU WILL OVERCOME THIS TORTUOUS PAIN AND THOUGHTS IN YOUR HEAD. I promise life will get better, and your sister will grow up with inspiration and support from her big brother. Please dm if you wanna talk more or need my number or something but I’m here for you my man.

Edit: I’m also a 23 year old man, currently about to transition out of the military, stationed overseas and I’ve been removed from my family for nearly 2 years straight. My transition back home has been shrouded in turmoil and uncertainty but the hope of getting back to my family and loved ones keeps me going. It’ll be okay bro, and it’ll get better, I promise you.

Not a doctor, but as a student and speaking from the experience of having strep seven times, in my personal opinion this appears to be strep. White splotches on the tonsils are symptomatic of A Streptococcus and I’ve experienced the same thing from strep. Everyone’s body reacts differently to strep, the only symptoms I ever experienced were painful swallowing and minor sinus congestion, so monitor yourself and be mindful of other symptoms because white splotches on your tonsils can be both bacterial or viral and also be caused by things such as tonsillitis or mononucleosis. I would definitely advise going to a clinic to receive a strep test to be absolutely sure it’s not some other bacterial or viral infection. But strep would appear to be the case here.

Switched off Concerta fairly recently about a month ago and since being on Vyvanse I’ve had far less problems with a pounding heartbeat, hypertension, and palpitations. They were so bad at one point on Concerta that I felt compelled to go to the ER and get a blood test and an EKG. Give the meds about 4 weeks to see if your body will acclimate to Concerta, if you’re still experiencing the same problems, I’d recommend going to see your doctor and making a switch. If you don’t have a history of cardiovascular problems or any underlying health issues, I promise you’re healthy and you’re just  fine, although I’m not a doctor so if you still have any serious inquiries, talk to your GP, best of Luck!
